blocks.text: Isaiah 18 contains 7 verses. It opens with: Ah, the land of the rustling of wings, which is beyond the rivers of Ethiopia; It concludes with: In that time shall a present be brought unto Jehovah of hosts `from' a people tall and smooth, even from a people terrible from their beginning onward, a nation that meteth out and treadeth down, whose land the rivers divide, to the place of the name of Jehovah of hosts, the mount Zion.
